import ast,sys; import hashlib,io,json,pathlib,subprocess,tokenize
repo, rev = sys.argv[1:]
ignored = {tokenize.COMMENT, tokenize.NL, tokenize.NEWLINE, tokenize.INDENT, tokenize.DEDENT, tokenize.ENCODING, tokenize.ENDMARKER}
for rel in ('tools/_revision.py', 'tools/mutants-owed-statements-r29-v4shapes.py'):
    before = subprocess.run(['timeout', '15', 'git', '-C', repo, 'show', rev + ':' + rel], check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=20).stdout
    after = pathlib.Path(repo, rel).read_bytes()
    btree, atree = (ast.dump(ast.parse(b), include_attributes=False) for b in (before, after))
    btokens, atokens = ([ (t.type, t.string) for t in tokenize.tokenize(io.BytesIO(b).readline) if t.type not in ignored ] for b in (before, after))
    result = {'file': rel, 'ast_unchanged': btree == atree, 'tokens_unchanged_ignoring_comments_and_whitespace': btokens == atokens, 'pristine_sha256': hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(), 'variant_sha256': hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest(), 'ast_sha256': hashlib.sha256(atree.encode()).hexdigest()}
    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
    assert result['ast_unchanged'] and result['tokens_unchanged_ignoring_comments_and_whitespace'], rel
